ja309:1.1: Sabbam idaṃ carimavataṃ, ubho dhammaṃ na passati, ubho pakatiyā cutā yo cāyaṃ sajjhāpayati yo ca dhammaṃ adhīyatīti.
ja309:2.1: Sālīnaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñje suciṃ maṃsūpasecanaṃ, tasmā etaṃ na sevāmi dhammaṃ isibhi sevitan ti.
ja309:3.1: Paribbaja, mahā loko, pacant' aññe pi pāṇino, mā tvaṃ adhammo ācarito asmā kumbham ivībhida.
ja309:4.1: Dhi-r-atthu taṃ yasalābhaṃ dhanalābhañ ca brāhmaṇa yā vutti vinipātena adhammacaraṇena vā ti.
